text_block_list.text:
After the race, I'm in the middle of
preparing ice
packs for Бива Хаяхидэ
when I hear her behind
me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Well? How did I look today?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I agree. I feel so much stronger after
summer—
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
N-nothing. I'm fine. Absolutely
everything is all
right.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Yes. I wanted to win this race so badly,
and my
legs didn't let me down.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
It was nothing like how they failed me
before, just
when I needed to run a little
faster...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I wonder if I can catch up to her now...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
That's exactly why we've been working
so hard on
my winning equation.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: So I can finally beat Brian.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
There are two more months until the
Arima Kinen.
Only a short while remains
until it's time for the
long-awaited
sibling showdown.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
